_comment: Staged pipeline configuration. Edit experiments.json for experiment membership; edit this file for processing, cache, analysis, or plotting behavior.

_field_help.pipeline.name: Pipeline identifier used by the staged runner.
_field_help.pipeline.user_id: Lab user folder used to resolve experiment data.
_field_help.pipeline.repo_base: Root directory containing the raw experiment repository.
_field_help.inputs.expids_file: JSON file containing the experiment ID lists for this pipeline.
_field_help.paths.cache_root: Root directory for all staged cache layers.
_field_help.source.channel: Suite2p channel used for dendrite and spine traces.
_field_help.source.soma_channel: Suite2p channel used for soma traces.
_field_help.source.bouton_channel: Suite2p channel used for bouton traces.
_field_help.processing.event_detection_method: Calcium-event detector used to calculate event activity and frequency; supports amplitude, derivative, and combined.
_field_help.processing.combined_event_window_frames: Frame window used by the combined detector to match amplitude and derivative evidence.
_field_help.processing.state_mode: State-selection mode used for movie and sleep comparisons.
_field_help.processing.movie_trial_types: Movie trial types included in the state comparison input.
_field_help.classification.visual_response_metric: Metric used by the initial ROI visual-response classification.
_field_help.classification.active_roi_filter: Per-ROI-type opt-in filter requiring a minimum number of detected events.
_field_help.classification.preferred_state.enabled: Enable preferred-state classification, including ties when multiple states are equally active.
_field_help.shuffle.null_model: Null model used for shuffled data.
_field_help.analysis.families: Analysis-family names to run after the initial analysis and ROI classification stages.
_field_help.cache.mode: Cache update policy; incremental mode reuses valid data and adds only new experiments.
_field_help.cache.validate_source_signatures: Validate raw-source signatures before reusing source-cache records.
_field_help.cache.archive_removed_expids: Keep removed experiment records in an archive instead of silently discarding them.
_field_help.plots.profile: Plot profile controlling the generated figure families.
_field_help.plots.plots_only: Reuse cached outputs and regenerate plots without recomputing analysis tables.
_field_help.initial_analysis.generate_general_figure: Write the initial-analysis frequency, distribution, and overlap plots under the general figures directory.
_field_help.initial_analysis.state_tie_absolute_tole: Absolute tolerance used when deciding whether two states are tied for the preferred state.
_field_help.initial_analysis.state_tie_relative_tole: Relative tolerance used when deciding whether two states are tied for the preferred state.
